{"code": "from IPython.display import display

# Step 1: Deduplicate patients — keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: Filter to treatment arm
treatment_only = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Step 3: Compute fraction who responded
num_responded = treatment_only['responded'].sum()
total_treatment = len(treatment_only)
fraction_responded = num_responded / total_treatment

# Print results
display(treatment_only[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'arm', 'responded']].head(10))
print(f"Number of unique patients in treatment arm after deduplication: {len(treatment_only)}")
print(f"Number of responses: {num_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded:.4f}")"}
